info.title: Anchanto WMS (Wareo3) API called by JPluger
info.description:
The HTTP surface JPluger's `wms3` area calls ON ANCHANTO WMS, reconstructed from the call sites so a local mock can answer it. Scope: v2 only, plus POST /oauth/token and the live v1 exceptions (ops 9, 26, 27).

NOT THE OMS API. docs/anchanto-oms-api.md covers the OMS Open API that the `wms` area calls, where "WMS" names the third-party partner. The two share zero paths and the wms3 area references SS_DOMAIN in zero files.

HOST: ${WMS_3_URL} -- wms-api.anchanto.com (prod), uatapi.anchanto.com (stage/uat), tst-wareo3.anchanto.com (dev/test/local), scrwms-api.anchanto.com (scarlett-prod). Ops 26-27 use ${WREO_DOMAIN}, same host family.

AUTH: real OAuth2, not a flat bearer. POST /oauth/token serves both the initial basic-auth grant and the refresh grant. /rest/v1/tokens/generate is legacy v1 and its token is never used for a v2 call, so a mock implementing only that authenticates nothing.

TWO HEADERS THAT LOOK ALIKE: `warehouse-code` (kebab-case) is a HEADER; `warehouse_code` (snake_case) is a body field. Both constants sit side by side in Wms3Constants. Not interchangeable.

customer_code IS NOT CHOSEN BY THE CALLER: every v2 path is scoped by it and it comes from the Kafka message header EHeaderKeys.CUSTOMER_CODE.

ENVELOPES: every write body is wrapped in one named key -- b2c_order, b2b_order, product, supplier, buyer, consignment. Every read answers {summary, status_code, data:{id,type,attributes}}. There is no {"payload":[...]} anywhere, unlike the OMS API.

ONE PUT: /rest/v2/customers/{customer_code}/products/{sku}. Everything else is POST, including every update; suppliers and buyers update via a named sub-resource.

CAMELCASE INSIDE SNAKE_CASE BODIES IS REAL: orderNumber, externalReturnOrderNumber and the deliveryDetails members carry no @SerializedName, so Gson emits the Java name.

SPEC FORMAT: Swagger 2.0 deliberately -- mock.py reads responses.<code>.examples["application/json"], responses.<code>.schema and #/definitions/..., which are 2.0 shapes. An OpenAPI 3 version routes correctly and then answers every operation with an empty body.

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: OAuth2 access token from POST /oauth/token. Modelled as an apiKey header because Swagger 2.0 has no bearer scheme. Never validated by the mock.

post.description:
Op 1. THE live auth mechanism. /rest/v1/tokens/generate is legacy v1 and its token is never used for a v2 call.

The initial grant uses BASIC AUTH -- client credentials in the Authorization header, no body. The refresh grant posts RefreshTokenRequest to this same URL. customResponseTypeKey is `grant_type`, not the OAuth2 default `response_type`.

Call site: Wms3RequestHandler.createAuthorizationGrant, connector/wms3-connector/.../service/Wms3RequestHandler.java:128.

access_token_expire_in.description: AuthenticateResponseDTO maps this through a private setter setExpireTime, not a plain field.

TokenResponse.description: Answers both the initial basic-auth grant and the refresh grant; the client posts to the same URL for each.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Wms3OauthRefreshTokenRequest. The initial grant uses basic auth and carries no body.

order_number.description: Persisted by the caller. A mock must return it.

ProductResponse.description: Wms3ProductResponseDTO. `status` is a body field, distinct from the HTTP status.

SupplierResponse.description: Wms3SupplierResponseDTO<T>; data is Wms3SupplierDataResponseDTO for suppliers and buyers.

return_order_number.description: Persisted by the caller. A mock must return it.

OrderCreateResponse.description: Order creation deserializes into a raw JsonNode client-side, so no typed contract is enforced. This is the observed shape.

attributes.description: Attribute set varies by resource. The wrapper -- id/type/attributes -- is the stable part.

ResourceObject.description: JSON:API-style resource. WmsOrderDTO / WmsB2BResponseDataDTO both use it.

status_code.description: String in WmsGetOrderResponseDTO, Integer in WmsB2BGetOrderResponseDTO, int in WmsB2BGetConsignmentResponseDTO. Three types for one field across three DTOs.

ReadEnvelope.description: Every v2 read wraps its resource this way -- not the {"payload":[...]} the OMS API uses.

OrderItemsEnvelope.description: WmsGetOrderItemResponseDTO -- the only read that is a list and the only one with meta.

B2BOrderData.description: Wms3OrderCreateDataDTO -- b2b and sto. Adds supplier_code, is_stock_transfer, destination_store_code.

StoOrderCreateRequest.description: STO reuses the b2b envelope with is_stock_transfer true and destination_store_code set.

orderNumber.description: camelCase on the wire: the DTO carries no @SerializedName, so Gson emits the Java name.

UpdateUnassignedOrderRequest.description: Sent as a raw JsonNode; no typed DTO client-side.

product_dimensions_attributes.description: Unit-suffixed: length_cm, weight_gm. Not the bare height/weight the OMS API uses.

supplier_type.description: Present on the buyer payload too -- one DTO serves both.

PartyData.description: Wms3PartyDataDTO -- shared by suppliers and buyers.

consignment_items_attributes.description: Note the DTO class is misspelled Wms3ConsigmentDataDTO (one n); the wire field is not.
